facts.value: Study subject advising is provided to support students with various questions about their studies.

E! Week with a mentoring program is the ideal start for all Bachelor students. In a three-day program, first-year students learn about Goethe University, the department, our campus life, and the city of Frankfurt.
Bachelor meets Business invites an exciting selection of companies each winter semester. Master's students are also welcome.

The Dean's List aims to honor outstanding academic achievements and foster communication between students and companies. This special recognition is awarded each semester to the best Bachelor and Master's students.
Website provides information about the work, current projects, and engagement opportunities in student initiatives and the Wiwi student council.
